Many thanks for taking the time to leave your feedback. At St Peter’s Medical Centre, we always aim to offer a high standard of patient care, and we are very sorry that your experience on this occasion did not reflect this.

We are sorry to hear that you felt the member of staff you spoke with was unable to provide the information you needed regarding contraception services. We understand how frustrating this must have been and we apologise for any inconvenience caused.

We are not certain which member of staff you spoke with or which team they were from. If this was a member of our reception team, at St. Peter’s we make every effort to equip our receptionists with the training and guidance they need to support patients with a wide range of queries. That said, we recognise that for each individual team member, there can occasionally be small gaps in knowledge. Your feedback is extremely helpful as it allows us to reflect on where we can improve the information and support we provide. We always welcome feedback as an opportunity to learn and strengthen our services.

If you would be willing to contact us at the practice, we would really appreciate the opportunity to speak with you directly, apologise personally, and help ensure you receive the information or care you were looking for. Please feel free to contact us either by telephone: 020 8864 4868, or via our online PATCHS system, which can be accessed here: Patchs You are welcome to request to speak to our management team and one of us will call you back at the earliest opportunity. 

We would be happy to offer you an appointment with one of our practice nurses to discuss contraceptive options. Alternatively, some local pharmacies are now able to provide certain contraceptive pills without the need for a prescription. You can find pharmacies offering this service by visiting this NHS website and entering your postcode: https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/pharmacy/find-a-pharmacy-offering-contraceptive-pill-without-prescription

If you would prefer to explore the full range of contraceptive options, we generally signpost patients to the Caryl Thomas Clinic. You can find more information about the services they offer and book an appointment online here: https://shc.lnwh.nhs.uk/caryl-thomas-clinic/ or you can contact them directly on 020 3893 8575 or by email at LNWH-tr.HarrowISRH@nhs.net.

Thank you again for your feedback. If you are able to get in touch with the practice, we would be very happy to assist you further. Our apologies again. 

Many kind regards,

The Management Team

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback. We are committed to providing excellent care to all of our patients, and I am very sorry to learn that your recent experience at our practice did not meet your expectations.

After reviewing the circumstances, I would like to offer some context regarding how our service operates. Unfortunately, when a patient arrives late for their scheduled appointment, especially when the whole appointment slot has passed by the time the they reach the surgery, it is not always possible for the doctor to see them. In such cases, we offer to reschedule the appointment at the earliest opportunity. I’m pleased that we were able to book you another appointment the following day, and we hope this will allow us to provide the care you need.

As you may be aware, our clinicians work to very tight schedules, with most appointments being just 10 minutes long. When a patient arrives more than 10 minutes late, it becomes increasingly challenging to accommodate them without causing delays for other patients and putting extra pressure on the clinician. While we always strive to be flexible and understanding, recognising that a patient may be delayed for a variety of reasons, we must also consider the impact on other patients who are waiting to be seen. Therefore, unfortunately, we are not always able to accommodate a patient who has arrived late.

We appreciate that this may feel frustrating, especially when patients themselves may, at times, wait beyond their scheduled appointment time to be seen by the clinician. Please be assured that our team works hard to keep appointments running on time, but occasionally consultations overrun due to clinical necessity.

Once again, I am sorry that your experience fell short your expectations. I hope this explanation provides some insight into how we aim to balance timely care with providing a service that is fair to all patients.

We are grateful for your feedback, which helps us continually improve our services. Should you wish to discuss this matter further, please don’t hesitate to contact the practice directly. I would be happy arrange a convenient time to speak with you personally.

Many kind regards,

Louise Hewitt
Operations Manager
On behalf of St Peter’s Medical Centre Management Team

We always aim to provide a high level of compassionate customer care and I am sorry that you felt this was not what you received this time. We welcome such feedback as an opportunity to look into anything that may not be up to our usual standards, and to make necessary adjustments or improvements.

Even for those who are able, we recognise that there are sometime glitches with the software, as it was the case for you. We do feel that for those who are able to make their requests online, that we can offer a very convenient and efficient service through this route. Equally we make provision for those who can’t make their requests online to receive an excellent service with assistance by telephone.

I will try and give you a call to apologise personally and to let you know what we have done to improve the service. Once again, thank you for affording us the opportunity to review this process and to make improvements.

Louise Hewitt
